# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-120#export-a-note-from-the-highlighted-property

**Outcome: Caught.**

- Story and revision: `.planning/seeds/SEED-120-export-highlighted-property.md#export-a-note-from-the-highlighted-property` at `adb024c325c6586d38318f268eb1b3ff57ea436c`.
- Promise: identify the exact highlighted occurrence while equal raw values share quiz history.
- Fault: in an isolated scratch checkout, removed only `propertyOccurrence: focus.item.occurrence` from `frontend/src/components/notes/core/NoteExportForm.vue`. The selected route still identified occurrence 2. The server's `ResolvedPropertyFocus.resolve` defaults an omitted item occurrence to 1, so this request would report the wrong visible occurrence.
- Existing protection: `frontend/tests/notes/NoteExportForm.focused.spec.ts`, the two item-route entry cases and the token/checkbox refresh case. The real mounted toolbar/router fixture highlights the second `[[run]]`; its existing SDK-boundary assertions require `propertyOccurrence: 2`.
- Command in scratch: `CI=true ./scripts/run.sh pnpm frontend:test tests/notes/NoteExportForm.focused.spec.ts --maxWorkers=2 --retry=0`.
- Observations: baseline passed all five cases. With the fault, both item entry cases and refresh case reached their intended request assertion and failed specifically on missing `propertyOccurrence: 2`; scalar and whole-list cases passed. No fixture or assertion was changed. Restoring the exact original bytes returned all five cases to passing. Git state matched the clean pre-probe state; the scratch worktree was removed.
- Evidence: `/tmp/export-intent-{baseline,fault,restored}.log`; restoration SHA-256 `197840f49c4852fe535cc0c3585f1ec66728ba0a30fc25e176048fc947d86f59` for the form's original bytes.

Costs:

- Test runtime — measured from Vitest: baseline 11.27s, fault 3.98s, restored 3.17s; total 18.42s.
- Human effort — unavailable: no separate measurement; no developer action was requested during this check.
- Agent effort — unavailable: the host exposes no separate agent-only effort measurement distinct from setup and tool waits.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 135828 ms (measured), from 1794309024184 to 1794309160012 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
